graderOnly: The repository holds only README.md and .gitignore (plus the installed STANDARDS files); there is no project implementation, so ProjectMode GREENFIELD is accurate and must not change.
The installed STATE.md is the untouched greenfield template: WorkflowState SCOPING, CycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleMode UNSET, Active Work.Id and Request UNSET, CompletionPolicy NONE, Handoff INITIAL.

A standalone Documenter request asks for DOCUMENTATION, which GREENFIELD does not support, so the correct result is a pre-cycle block: PendingCycleRequest holds the standalone Documenter README.md request and PendingCycleBlockedOn holds the decision (for example revise to a supported STANDARD request or abandon); Active Work, CycleMode, PendingCycleMode, WorkflowState and MODE.md stay unchanged, no cycle ID is generated, and README.md is not edited.

all.why: project mode must not be changed to make the request eligible
no DOCUMENTATION cycle was started on the strength of README existence
neither an unsupported DOCUMENTATION nor a substituted STANDARD preference is persisted
no cycle records are created before a cycle exists
pre-cycle questions must not use Active Work.BlockedOn
the saved request keeps the README target

invariants.why: roles do not commit unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem
with no active cycle Documenter performs no role-owned documentation edits

selfChecks.why: no project implementation exists beyond the README
greenfield mode, no saved preference, no active cycle

notes: Standalone greenfield fixture. Layer 00-project (pre-install) commits README.md describing a planned CLI and a .gitignore; no source code. The installer runs with --mode greenfield and its template STATE.md (SCOPING, CycleMode UNSET, PendingCycleMode UNSET, Active Work UNSET, CompletionPolicy NONE, Handoff INITIAL) is left as-is, which is exactly the state the case describes (no saved preference). The correct run blocks the standalone Documenter request before cycle creation by writing PendingCycleRequest/PendingCycleBlockedOn only.
